scripts.build: bun run check-witnesses && bun run render-atlas:write
scripts.check-witnesses: cd .. && python3 computations/witness_staleness_tracker.py check || (echo '[build] NOTE: stale witnesses detected — see computations/witness-shas.json'; true)
scripts.render-atlas: cd .. && python3 computations/recursive_atom_knot_atlas_render.py 2>/dev/null || (echo '[build] NOTE: atlas render skipped (recursive_atom_knot_atlas_render.py moved to _deprecated/ in 191bd9f54; committed recursive-atom-knot-atlas.rendered.md remains the source of truth)' && true)
scripts.render-atlas:write: cd .. && (python3 computations/recursive_atom_knot_atlas_render.py > computations/recursive-atom-knot-atlas.rendered.md 2>/dev/null || echo '[build] NOTE: atlas render-write skipped (script in _deprecated/); using committed rendered file')
